jobs.title: Night Shift Security Officer – Healthcare Campus
jobs.description:
Ascension Saint Joseph in Chicago, IL seeks a Security Officer for night shift, full-time duties. You will maintain a safe environment, patrol premises, and respond to security threats while ensuring compliance with policies.

Required are a valid driver's license and basic certifications; prior security or related experience is preferred. The facility offers comprehensive benefits and a supportive work culture.

jobs.title: Healthcare Security Officer – Per Diem
jobs.description:
Endeavor Health seeks a part-time Per Diem Public Safety Officer for Swedish Hospital in Chicago, IL. The role involves unarmed security, patrols, incident reporting, and assisting with police investigations as needed. You will welcome patients and staff, provide directions, and help escort duties when possible.

Requires a High School Diploma or GED, and a valid Illinois FOID within 90 days. CPR certification within 90 days, and a valid driver’s license are also required.

jobs.title: Evening Security Officer Healthcare Campus

You will maintain a safe environment for patients and visitors, investigate incidents, and enforce regulations. A High School diploma or equivalent and a valid driver's license are required, along with preferred certifications like BLS and a Security Guard credential. Enjoy full-time hours with competitive pay and comprehensive health benefits, all in a mission-driven environment.

jobs.title: Security Supervisor – Pediatric Hospital Leadership
jobs.description:
Lurie Children’s Hospital of Chicago is seeking a Security Officer Supervisor to lead front-line teams on site, ensuring a safe environment for patients, families, staff and volunteers. The role includes training cadets, directing assignments, and enforcing hospital policies while maintaining excellent service standards.

Responsibilities encompass patrols, incident reporting, access control, dispatch operations, and emergency response across the Medical Center campus.
